title: Evidence bundle manifest
description: A local, self-contained set of artifacts for one work unit, listed by reference and pinned by digest. Every artifact is a file inside the bundle directory: nothing here is fetched, dereferenced over a network, or executed. The bundle proves that the references used by executor-evidence and cross-review resolve to inspectable local files whose bytes are the ones recorded. It proves nothing about human behavior, restricted-account execution, OS sandboxing, network containment, or credential isolation, and it grants no authority to commit, push, open a pull request, merge, deploy, or promote anything.

artifact_reference.description: A pointer to an artifact carried by this bundle. Deliberately the artifact-only narrowing of schemas/cross-review.schema.json#/$defs/evidence_reference: pass one resolves nothing else, so a 'file:', 'commit:', or 'run:' reference — which names something outside the bundle — is refused rather than silently skipped. A conformance scenario derives this pattern from the shared one so the two cannot drift.

artifact_path.description: A path to a file inside the bundle directory, relative to the manifest. The remaining rules — no absolute path, no '..', no .git, no symlink, no directory, no URL or drive syntax, no shell metacharacter — are enforced by scripts/validate-evidence-bundle.sh, where a rejection can name which rule refused it.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex digest of the artifact's bytes. Recomputed on every validation; a recorded digest is a claim until it is.

artifact_kind.description: Public artifact kind. Narrow on purpose: 'other' is for something real that this list does not name, never a way to avoid declaring what an artifact is.

refs.description: The six references a bundle names for one work unit. Every one is required as a key, because 'this bundle does not say' and 'this bundle says there is none' are different records. packet_ref and result_ref need not carry an artifact in pass one; if they do, that artifact resolves and hash-checks like any other.

authority.description: What this bundle says about promotion, which is only ever nothing. Stated as explicit always-false fields rather than left to prose, so a bundle that claims otherwise is rejected by a check instead of by a reader.

promotion_authorized_by_this_bundle.description: Always false. Resolving evidence is not authorizing anything.

merge_authorized_by_this_bundle.description: Always false. The operator merges, by hand, after watching the behavior check.
